subject: Post-demo: proposed trial action plan and success criteria — MeridianOps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@meridianops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: proposed trial action plan and success criteria — MeridianOps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + a concrete POC/trial proposal so your team can review and loop in procurement/security. I’ve attached a one-page POC charter (meridianops-poc-charter.pdf) and an initial cost estimate.

High-level summary of what we covered:
- Use case: customer support triage + automated categorization for incoming tickets (English only to start).
- Redwood will serve a reserved trial endpoint with a sandbox workspace and short-lived API keys.
- Data flow: ticket text -> Redwood API -> classification + suggested reply draft. We discussed obfuscation rules for sensitive PII.

Proposed trial plan (2-week focused run):
1) Week 0 (prep, 3–5 business days): account setup, dataset sampling, SSO access, baseline metrics.
2) Week 1 (test run): integrate SDK, run 1,000 real-ish requests using sampled ticket set.
3) Week 2 (validation): evaluate metrics, handoff to engineering to validate latency and integration.

Success criteria (pass/fail gating) — please confirm these align with your stakeholders:
- Accuracy: 90%+ correct category on gold set (3 label sample).
- Latency: median end-to-end response < 250ms for 256-token average payload.
- Quality: suggested replies considered usable > 70% by CS raters (N=50).
- Stability: no errors > 0.5% across run.

Owners & roles: 
- MeridianOps: Alex Johnson (Product Owner), Priya Raman (Engineering lead), Procurement (procurement@meridianops.com) for PO/contract.
- Redwood: Hannah Schmitt (AM, primary contact), Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer — integration + observability), Monica Patel (Customer Reliability — onboarding).

What we need from MeridianOps to start:
- 250–500 sample tickets with labels (or a small anonymized export) and a short priority list of intents.
- SSO/IdP test account or list of allowed IPs for the sandbox.
- Point of contact for procurement & security (contract redlines + SOC 2 evidence).

Attachments: meridianops-poc-charter.pdf (POC scope, timeline, acceptance), redwood-cost-estimate.xlsx (trial pricing assumptions).

Requested next steps:
- Alex: confirm success criteria + owners and whether procurement should be looped now or after scope sign-off.
- Priya: can you confirm a tentative integration window next week for the SDK?

Happy to hop on a 20–30m follow-up to finalize. Thanks —

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed trial action plan and success criteria — MeridianOps

Thanks Hannah — great demo, and the proposed plan looks sensible. A couple of clarifying items from our side: 

1) Security & compliance: our security team will need to review SOC 2 evidence and an encryption diagram. Can you share a short doc outlining how keys are managed for the sandbox?
2) Data handling: we need to confirm whether logs will be retained beyond the trial and whether we can opt-out of persistent storage.
3) Procurement: procurement@meridianops.com is on copy. For budgeting, our legal will want a simple SOW + an estimated spend cap for the trial.

Regarding timeline — Priya and I are OK to aim to start integration the week of 29 Mar (your Week 0 as prep). Priya, are there any constraints on your side?

Also, can Ben run a short session (30m) with our platform team to review the SDK and observability hooks?

Appreciate the clarity — we’ll have procurement confirm contract cadence once we see the SOW.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Product | MeridianOps
alex.johnson@meridianops.com | +1 (206) 555-0199
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@meridianops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@meridianops.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed trial action plan and success criteria — MeridianOps

Alex — thanks, noted. Quick answers and an updated, slightly more operational plan below. I pasted the key bits so procurement/security can skim.

Security & keys:
- Sandbox: short-lived API keys issued per-user with automated rotation (48h default).
- Customers who request zero-persist can enable ephemeral logging: request flag at provisioning time; logs then retained for 7 days and removed.
- We’ll share the SOC 2 summary + encryption-at-rest/transport diagram. Expect a doc in the next 48 hours.

Procurement/SOW & spend cap:
- For a 2-week POC our estimate is ~$3,200 (see attached redwood-cost-estimate.xlsx). If you want strict spend cap we can gate the endpoint and alert you at 80% usage.

Operationalized trial timeline (revised):
- Fri 26 Mar: Redwood sends SOW + SOC 2 summary + key management diagram. (Action: Hannah)
- Mon 29 Mar: provisioning + sandbox API keys + Ben-led SDK walkthrough (30m). (Action: Ben/Monica)
- Tue 30 Mar–Thu 1 Apr: integration window (sample traffic, smoke tests). (Action: Priya)
- Fri 2 Apr–Thu 8 Apr: validation run and quality review (MeridianOps rates suggested replies). (Action: Alex/Priya)
- Fri 9 Apr: POC closeout meeting and acceptance decision. (Action: all)

Success criteria (revised and measurable):
- Category accuracy >= 90% on a 250-sample gold set (we’ll provide a scoring script).
- Suggested replies rated >= 70% usable by 3 CS raters (we’ll provide the rubric).
- Median end-to-end latency <= 250ms (256-token baseline).
- No stability incidents > 1% error rate across total calls.

Action items (who does what):
- Hannah (Redwood): send SOW & SOC2 + key diagram by Fri 26 Mar; finalize cost cap option.
- Ben (Redwood): schedule SDK walkthrough (30m) for Mon 29 Mar; provide observability checklist.
- Monica (Redwood): stand up sandbox and create test API keys for MeridianOps.
- Alex (MeridianOps): provide 250 labeled samples or confirm timeline for anonymized export.
- Priya (MeridianOps): confirm integration resources and IP allowlist or SSO test account.
- Procurement (MeridianOps): review SOW once sent — procurement@meridianops.com

If everyone agrees, I’ll send a short SOW and a calendar invite for Ben’s walkthrough.

Thanks —
Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
